items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: plus the nightclubs you played with: Slim Gaillard and Della Reese and who else here?

ctx.x: Besides that, and all this recording and all the other things you'd done, plus the nightclubs you played with: Slim Gaillard and Della Reese and who else here?
Oh, Dinah Shore, Polly Bergen, Paul Anka, George Maharis, Joe Williams ...
